name: B-Side
description: Your music library in Orca's sidebar, on Windows: browse, search and play the music on your PC, with synced lyrics and three skins. AIMP plays it.

cover.alt: B-Side's three skins fanned out, Cassette, Vinyl and CD, each playing a demo track with synced lyrics, beside the words "Your music library, in Orca's sidebar"

screenshots.alt: The same panel in three skins: CD in the colours of its cover, Vinyl with serif lyrics and old gold, Cassette in pixel type and cyan
screenshots.caption: Three skins. Press the logo to switch

screenshots.alt: The panel dragged wide: a grid of demo albums beside Now Playing with synced lyrics
screenshots.caption: Your whole collection beside what is playing

screenshots.alt: Synced lyrics in Vinyl, CD and Cassette at three sizes, the current line highlighted, with A- and A+ in the corner
screenshots.caption: Synced lyrics, at the size you read best

screenshots.alt: The CD skin with three demo covers, each tinting the whole panel in its own colours, with the format of each track
screenshots.caption: CD takes its colours from every cover

screenshots.alt: Search for "rio" finding the artist Ríos de Ámbar y Sal, the album Río Lento de Sal and its tracks, beside that album's page
screenshots.caption: Instant search that ignores accents

settings.title: Library folders
settings.description: Folders with your music, one per line (for example C:\Users\you\Music). Leave empty to use the Windows Music folder. B-Side only reads them; files that are only in the cloud (OneDrive Files On-Demand) are listed by name and never downloaded.

settings.title: Native helper
settings.description: Download B-Side's native AIMP helper (about 0.5 MB) from this version's GitHub release on first use, check its SHA-256 and use it: less memory and faster answers. Turn off to always use the PowerShell helper (for example on a work PC that blocks downloaded programs).
